schema.text: What is your highest completed level of education?
schema.help: If you studied abroad, choose the closest level. If you are still studying, choose the last level you completed.

en.#What is your highest completed level of: What is your highest completed level of education?
en.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: If you studied abroad, choose the closest level. If you are still studying, choose the last level you completed.

fr.#What is your highest completed level of: Quel est le niveau d’études le plus élevé que vous avez terminé ?
fr.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: Si vous avez fait vos études à l’étranger, choisissez le niveau le plus proche. Si vous êtes encore en études, choisissez le dernier niveau que vous avez terminé.

it.#What is your highest completed level of: Qual è il livello di istruzione più alto che hai completato?
it.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: Se hai studiato all’estero, scegli il livello più vicino. Se stai ancora studiando, scegli l’ultimo livello che hai completato.

de.#What is your highest completed level of: Was ist Ihr höchster abgeschlossener Bildungsabschluss?
de.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: Wenn Sie im Ausland zur Schule gegangen sind oder studiert haben, wählen Sie den am ehesten passenden Abschluss. Wenn Sie noch in Ausbildung sind, wählen Sie den letzten Abschluss, den Sie erreicht haben.

tr.#What is your highest completed level of: Tamamladığınız en yüksek eğitim düzeyi nedir?
tr.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: Yurt dışında okuduysanız, en yakın düzeyi seçin. Hâlâ okuyorsanız, tamamladığınız son düzeyi seçin.

hu.#What is your highest completed level of: Mi a legmagasabb befejezett iskolai végzettsége?
hu.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: Ha külföldön tanult, válassza a legközelebbi szintet. Ha még tanul, válassza az utolsó befejezett szintet.

fa.#What is your highest completed level of: بالاترین سطح تحصیلی که به پایان رسانده‌اید چیست؟
fa.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: اگر در خارج از کشور تحصیل کرده‌اید، نزدیک‌ترین سطح را انتخاب کنید. اگر هنوز در حال تحصیل هستید، آخرین سطحی را که به پایان رسانده‌اید انتخاب کنید.

ar.#If you studied abroad, choose the close: عند الدراسة في الخارج، يُرجى اختيار أقرب مستوى. وعند الاستمرار في الدراسة، يُرجى اختيار آخر مستوى أُكمل.
